webdriver_url.title: Local WebDriver URL
webdriver_url.description: Loopback address of a WebDriver you started, such as http://127.0.0.1:9515. Leave empty to disable capture.

media_enabled.title: Enable public-domain media catalog
media_enabled.description: Permit explicitly requested search and download from the Metropolitan Museum of Art collection.

image_api_base.title: Image API base URL
image_api_base.description: HTTPS API root, including its version path if needed. Leave empty to disable generation and editing.

image_model.title: Image model
image_model.description: Exact model ID accepted by the configured image API.
